item_short_desc: The Lanksy Blademedic is a compact knife sharpener that is specially designed for use in the field. This versatile tactical knife sharpener can accommodate both regular and serrated blades.
description: Four Different Sharpeners , Tungsten Carbide For Setting An , Edge To A Dull Blade Ceramic For Polishing And Finishing An Edge , Ceramic Edge For Serrated Blades , Diamond-Tapered Rod , For Fast Reconditioning And Maintenance And For Sharpening Gut Hooks
